title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop as a rectangle with lines from (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0342, 0.0), then from (0.0342, 0.0) to (0.0342, 0.0342), followed by (0.0342, 0.0342) to (0.0, 0.0342), and finally from (0.0, 0.0342) back to (0.0, 0.0). Inside this rectangle, draw a second loop as a smaller rectangle with lines from (0.0026, 0.0026) to (0.0316, 0.0026), then from (0.0316, 0.0026) to (0.0316, 0.0316), followed by (0.0316, 0.0316) to (0.0026, 0.0316), and finally from (0.0026, 0.0316) back to (0.0026, 0.0026). Apply a scaling factor of 0.0342 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the two-dimensional sketch using the Euler angles set to zero degrees and translate it using the translation vector set to zero. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units, ensuring that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction and results in a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical body with a flat top are 0.03421052631578947 units in length, 0.03421052631578947 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

# Create the outer rectangle
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0, 0.0).lineTo(0.0342, 0.0).lineTo(0.0342, 0.0342).lineTo(0.0, 0.0342).close()

# Create the inner rectangle

# Extrude the sketch
r = sketch.extrude(0.75)

import cadquery as cq

# Dimensions
outer = 0.0342
wall = 0.006
height = 0.75

# Create the outer square
outer_sq = cq.Workplane("XY").rect(outer, outer)

# Create the inner square (hollow center)
inner_sq = cq.Workplane("XY").rect(outer - 2 * wall, outer - 2 * wall)

# Build the hollow square tube
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .rect(outer, outer)
    .rect(outer - 2 * wall, outer - 2 * wall)
    .extrude(height)
)
